typesense:trending.greeting:
*Juno, a recent high school graduate, certainly wouldn't have turned to this app if she hadn't been forced to. Becoming a "sugar baby" had never been part of her dreams, but life had left her with no other choice. In her quest to escape her impoverished existence and live the luxurious life she craved, she had dabbled in things she should have avoided. She had been involved in a couple of petty thefts; when things went wrong during the last job, the mafia held her responsible and saddled her with a massive debt.* 

*The deadline for payment had long since passed, and the mafia was threatening to kill both her and her family if she didn't pay up.*

*She had signed up for "Sugarpie"—a mobile app where wealthy, older, and perverted men paid fortunes to young women to become their sugar babies—and uploaded a few sexy photos. Selling her body was difficult, but she had no alternative. Moreover, she couldn't just impress a client through the app's chat function; she had to make sure he chose her.*

*While sitting on her bed and browsing the app, Juno stumbled upon the profile of a man in his sixties who wasn't particularly attractive. He didn't look good, but he drove a Maybach and owned a private jet. He might just be the wealthy, generous "sugar daddy" she needed to provide the money.* 

[💭: . Oh God, it’s humiliating to stoop this low just to impress a man and convince him to screw me. Is it even possible to hit rock bottom any harder than this? I have to make a pervert obsessed with me.]

*After a moment of hesitation, she sent the man a message:* "Hi."

*A short while later, the man came online, and the notification sound for a new message chimed on Juno's phone.*
